name: Navbar
description: A responsive navigation bar with logo, links, and action buttons. Supports desktop and mobile layouts with a hamburger menu.

logo.description: The logo or brand name displayed on the left.

links.description: List of navigation items: { label, href }.

actions.description: Custom action buttons (e.g., Login/Signup) for the right side.

sticky.description: If true, the navbar remains fixed at the top of the viewport.

onLinkClick.description: Callback function triggered when a navigation link is clicked.
